rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Secret speech remains latent, while public speech brings knowledge from potentiality into actuality.
rows.anchor: { سواء منكم من أسر القول } في مكمن استعداده { ومن جهر به } بإبراز العلم من القوة إلى الفعل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hidden person is immersed in the self’s dark night, while the traveler leaves the self’s station for the spirit’s daylight.
rows.anchor: بليل ظلمة نفسه { و } من هو { سارب } بخروجه من مقام النفس وذهابه في نهار نور الروح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Successive guardians are reinforcements from the unseen realm, reaching people by God’s command and protecting them from imaginative and illusory powers.
rows.anchor: { له معقبات } أمداد متعاقبة من الملكوت واصلة إليه من أمر الله { يحفظونه من } خطفات جن القوى الخيالية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These reinforcements also protect from domination by animal and predatory faculties.
rows.anchor: وغلبات البهيمية والسبعية وإهلاكها إياه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God changes outward or inward blessing and perfection when a community changes its preparedness and receptivity.
rows.anchor: { إن الله لا يغير ما بقوم } من نعمة وكمال ظاهر أو باطن { حتى يغيروا ما بأنفسهم } من الاستعداد وقوة القبول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Divine effusion flows continuously and generally like water; crops differ despite being watered by the same source.
rows.anchor: فإن الفيض الإلهي عام متصل كالماء الجاري

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Clouded preparedness clouds its effusion and increases evil.
rows.anchor: فمن تكدر استعداده تكدر فيضه فزاد في شره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Purified preparedness clarifies its effusion and increases good.
rows.anchor: ومن تصفىاستعداده تصفى فيضه فزاد في خيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Even outward blessings turn into afflictions only through some manifest or hidden deserving cause.
rows.anchor: وكذا النعم الظاهرة لا بد في تغيرها إلى النقم من استحقاق جلي أو خفي

rows.speaker: المحققون
rows.claim: The verifiers say that unfailing supplication is uttered by the tongue of preparedness.
rows.anchor: قال المحققون: إن الدعاء الذي لا يتخلف عنه الاستجابة

rows.speaker: بعض السلف
rows.claim: A predecessor said that a mouse tore his shoes and took this as proof of a sin, since God would not otherwise have empowered it against him.
rows.anchor: ما أعلم ذلك إلا بذنب أحدثته وإلا ما سلطها الله علي

rows.speaker: الشاعر
rows.claim: An unnamed poet’s line supports the thought that loss of property reflects one’s own position or fault.
rows.anchor: وتمثل بقول الشاعر: لو كنت من مازن لم تستبح إبلي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The believers whose hearts find rest are those who turn back to God and have knowledge-based faith in the unseen.
rows.anchor: { الذين آمنوا } أي: المنيبون الذين آمنوا الإيمان العلمي بالغيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Self-remembrance uses the tongue and reflection on blessings; heart-remembrance contemplates the unseen realm and the attributes of beauty and majesty.
rows.anchor: ذكر النفس باللسان والتفكر في النعم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Remembrance ascends through self, heart, secret, spirit, and hidden faculty, culminating in remembrance of God through annihilation in Him.
rows.anchor: وذكر الروح بالمشاهدة، وذكر الخفاء بالمناغاة في المعاشقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The self’s attributes and inner talk unsettle it and color the heart; remembering God steadies the self and removes its whispers.
rows.anchor: والنفس تضطرب بظهور صفاتها وأحاديثها وتطيش فيتلون القلب بسببها

rows.speaker: النبي ﷺ
rows.claim: The Prophet is cited as saying Satan places his trunk on a person’s heart, but withdraws when God is remembered, allowing the heart to rest.
rows.anchor: كما قال عليه الصلاة والسلام: " إن الشيطان يضع خرطومه على قلب ابن آدم، فإذا ذكر الله خنس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heart also rests through contemplation of the unseen realm and lights of dominion; other forms of remembrance follow only after tranquility.
rows.anchor: وكذا ذكر القلب بالتفكر في الملكوت ومطالعة أنوار الجبروت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Righteous action here means purifying and adorning the soul; Ṭūbā is reaching primordial nature and perfection of attributes.
rows.anchor: والعمل الصالح ههنا: التزكية والتحلية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A good return is entry into the heart’s garden, the garden of attributes.
rows.anchor: الدخول في جنة القلب، جنة الصفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The patient and grateful are believers in the unseen; patience and gratitude are stations before arrival, pursued during faith and the journey toward trust in God.
rows.anchor: أي: لكل مؤمن بالإيمان الغيبي إذ الصبر والشكر مقامان للسالك قبل الوصول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The signs drawn upon in the journey are God’s acts; each blessing or guidance calls for thanks in speech, heart, and obedient action.
rows.anchor: آياته التي يعتبر بها ويستمدها يتمسك بها ويعتمدها في سلوكه هي الأفعال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gratitude means recognizing a blessing as from God and receiving, accepting, obeying, and acting upon it properly through the limbs.
rows.anchor: شكره باللسان وبالقلب بتصوره من عند الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Patience restrains complaint, recalls that all belong to God and return to Him, binds the heart to possible benefit, and keeps the limbs from agitation.
rows.anchor: وربط القلب وتصور أن له فيه خير أو مصلحة وإلا لما ابتلاه الله به ومنع الجوارح عن الاضطراب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being told to leave means expulsion from the sacred world’s paradise because the devil is not stripped of materiality.
rows.anchor: مرجوم، مطرود منها لكونك غير مجرد عن المادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The curse is distance in rank until either the lesser resurrection, when the soul separates from the body, or the greater resurrection, annihilation in unity.
rows.anchor: لعنة البعد في الرتبة { إلى يوم } القيامة الصغرى وتجرد النفس عن البدن بقطع علاقتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The devil promises to adorn lower desires and pleasures and mislead everyone except God’s purified servants.
rows.anchor: الشهوات واللذات في الجهة السفلية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The purified servants are those God selected, cleansed of ego and natural attachment, and stripped of selfhood through turning toward Him.
rows.anchor: أي: المخصوصين بك، الذين أخلصتهم من شوائب صفات النفس وطهرتهم من دنس تعلق الطبيعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, they are those who make their deeds solely for God, without seeking another share in them.
rows.anchor: أو الذين أخلصوا أعمالهم لك من غير حظ لغيرك فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The straight path is a true, proper way whose observance has no crookedness.
rows.anchor: حق نهجه ومراعاته { مستقيم } لا اعوجاج فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The devil has no dominion over God’s purified servants; only those akin to him in delusion and distance from God’s path follow him.
rows.anchor: وهو أن لا سلطان لك على عبادي المخلصين إلا الذين يناسبونك في الغواية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hell’s seven gates are the five senses, desire, and anger; each gate is assigned an organ or a group of people dominated by its faculty.
rows.anchor: { لها سبعة أبواب } هي الحواس الخمس والشهوة والغضب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, each gate’s assigned portion is a group of people entering through the faculty that dominates them.
rows.anchor: أو بعض من الخلق يختصون بالدخول منه لغلبة قوة ذلك الباب عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God requires the upright path and guides its people; the path of tawhid belongs to Him, as the verse about God being on a straight path indicates.
rows.anchor: أي: عليه لزوم السبيل المستقيم والهداية إليها لأهله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Paths other than tawhid are crooked, deviate from truth, and lead inevitably to falsehood; universal guidance would contradict wisdom.
rows.anchor: جائر عادل عن الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The foremost monotheists are taken by God Himself; among the righteous, those who transcend the self and reach the heart’s knowledge and virtues are taken by the Angel of Death.
rows.anchor: قد مر أن السابقين الموحدين يتوفاهم الله تعالى بذاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worshippers, ascetics, and law-followers who remain at the self’s station are taken by angels of mercy with glad tidings of the self’s garden of actions and effects.
rows.anchor: ومن كان في مقام النفس من العباد والصلحاء والزهاد والمتشرعين الذين لم يتجردوا عن علائق البدن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wicked are taken by angels of punishment; unseen powers connected to souls assume their qualities, appearing dark and terrifying to veiled souls.
rows.anchor: الأشرار الأشقياء فكيفما كانوا تتوفاهم ملائكة العذاب

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: A report says the Angel of Death appears in the form of the dying person’s character, so a person with dark traits sees a terrifying form and becomes fearful and submissive.
rows.anchor: إنما يظهر ملك الموت على صورة أخلاق المحتضر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their submission means they soften and abandon defiance; they claim they did no wrong, are reminded that God knows their deeds, and are told to enter hell’s gates of actions.
rows.anchor: تركوا العناد والتمرد وقالوا: { ما كنا نعمل من سوء }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every created thing has an essence belonging to its unseen kingdom; its shadow is the embodied form through which it appears.
rows.anchor: أي: ذات وحقيقة مخلوقة، أية ذات كانت من المخلوقات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The right and left signify good and evil; forms move toward both kinds of action at God’s command, submitting and unable to resist.
rows.anchor: أي: عن جهة الخير والشر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heavens comprise the realm of spirits, including the people of dominion and the pure, disembodied spirits.
rows.anchor: في عالم الأرواح من أهل الجبروت والملكوت والأرواح المجردة المقدسة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earth comprises the bodily realm, including animals, humans, trees, all souls, and earthly and heavenly powers.
rows.anchor: في عالم الأجساد من الدواب والأناسي والأشجار وجميع النفوس والقوى الأرضية والسماوية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their lack of arrogance means they do not resist submission to God’s command.
rows.anchor: لا يمتنعون عن الانقياد والتذلل لأمره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fearing their Lord from above means being broken and affected by His domination, influence, and loftiness over them; they obey willingly and cannot do otherwise.
rows.anchor: أي: ينكسرون ويتأثرون وينفعلون منه انفعال الخائف { من فوقهم } من قهره وتأثيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They do what they are commanded willingly and submissively, with no ability to do otherwise.
rows.anchor: طوعا وانقيادا بحيث لا يسعهم فعل غيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A prophet’s perfection gathers all perfections of his community and exceeds any rank its members can reach; the community receives good qualities through him and its existence flows from his.
rows.anchor: قد مر أن كل نبي يبعث في قوم يكون كماله شاملا لجميع كمالات أمته

rows.speaker: النبي ﷺ
rows.claim: The Prophet is cited as saying that weighed against his community he would outweigh them, illustrating Abraham’s being a community in himself.
rows.anchor: ولهذا قال عليه الصلاة والسلام: " لو وزنت بأمتي لرجحت بهم "

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham’s obedience is complete submission: no hair moves except by God’s command as tawhid overcomes and effaces his attributes in God’s.
rows.anchor: منقادا بحيث لا يتحرك منه شعرة إلا بأمره لاستيلاء سلطان التوحيد عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham is called God’s intimate friend because the Real is mixed with him in witnessing; intimacy retains a remnant of self that signals duality.
rows.anchor: فخلته عبارة عن مزج بقية من ذاته تؤذن بالإثنينية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: By contrast, Muhammad is called God’s beloved because no remnant of self remained in him; this complete effacement is obedience for God, rather than through God.
rows.anchor: أما ترى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم لما لم يبق منه شيء من بقيته سمي حبيب الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author distinguishes obedience for God from obedience through God, citing that Muhammad’s patience is only by God.
rows.anchor: قال لمحمد عليه الصلاة والسلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham was a hanif by turning from every falsehood, even his own existence and the existence of all besides God.
rows.anchor: مائلا عن كل باطل حتى عن وجوده ووجود كل ما سواه تعالى معرضا عن إثباته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He was no polytheist because he did not attribute existence or causal influence to another.
rows.anchor: بنسبة الوجود والتأثير إلى الغير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gratitude means using blessings properly, acting through divine attributes without ulterior purpose and directing each blessing toward its perfection according to divine wisdom.
rows.anchor: أي: مستعملا لها على الوجه الذي ينبغي لكونه متصرفا فيها بصفات الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God selected Abraham through primordial care without an intervening deed; as one of the beloved, his unveilings preceded his wayfaring.
rows.anchor: اختاره في العناية الأولى بلا توسط عمل منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After unveiling and arrival at unity, Abraham was guided to the path as an example, returning from unity to differentiated multiplicity so prophetic teaching could give each level its due.
rows.anchor: أي: بعد الكشف والتوحيد والوصول إلى عين الجمع هداه إلى سلوك صراطه ليقتدي به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Merciful is majestic and veiled behind creatures, yet beautiful and manifested to all through mercy, since nothing could exist without that universal mercy.
rows.anchor: أي: ربك الجليل، المحتجب بحجب المخلوقات لجلاله، هو الجميل، المتجلي بجمال رحمته على الكل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The name al-Raḥmān belongs uniquely to God because only He can grant universal effusion to all.
rows.anchor: ولهذا اختص الرحمن به دون الرحيم لامتناع عموم الفيض للكل إلا منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s establishment on the throne of all existence is the manifestation of His merciful attribute and universal effusion to every being.
rows.anchor: فكما استوى على عرش وجود الكل بظهور الصفة الرحمانية فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Likewise, God is fully manifest on the Prophet’s heart through all His attributes, whose effects reach all creatures, making him a mercy to the worlds and his prophethood universal and final.
rows.anchor: فكذا استوى على عرش قلبك بظهور جميع صفاته فيه ووصول أثرها منه إلى جميع الخلائق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Istiwa means complete manifestation in the Prophet, the only locus corresponding to all attributes; he had no shadow because no self remained unrealized in God after complete annihilation.
rows.anchor: ظهوره فيه سويا تاما إذ لا يطابق كلها مظهر غيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The warning of punishment means punishment in nature’s hell and matter’s abyss for whoever opposes and turns away.
rows.anchor: في جحيم الطبيعة وهاوية الهيولى على من خالفه وأعرض عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh’s question about the Lord indicates the self’s veiling from its Lord.
rows.anchor: إشارة إلى احتجاب النفس من جناب الرب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s giving each thing its form and guiding it means guiding the self by proof: He gives each being suitable constitution, faculties, benefits, aims, and direction to attain them.
rows.anchor: هداية لها بالدليل وتبصيرا بالحجة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh’s question about earlier generations signals the self’s concealment from resurrection, afterlife happiness and misery, and God’s comprehensive knowledge of them.
rows.anchor: إشارة إلى احتجابها عن المعاد والأحوال الأخروية من السعادة والشقاوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Knowledge of the afterlife depends on knowing God through His attributes, so Moses answers that God’s eternal, errorless knowledge encompasses the generations and their states and is recorded in the Preserved Tablet.
rows.anchor: أجاب بإحاطة علمه بها وبأحوالها مع كثرتها وكون ذلك العلم مثبتا في اللوح المحفوظ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earth made as a cradle is the bodily realm for bodily faculties, and its paths are limbs and organs such as the eye, ear, and nose.
rows.anchor: أيها القوى البدنية أرض البدن { مهدا وسلك لكم فيها سبلا } من الأعضاء والجوارح كالعين والأذن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Water from the spirit’s heaven means perception and spiritual assistance; from it come perceptions, actions, properties, states, and dispositions specific to each faculty.
rows.anchor: من سماء الروح ماء الإدراك والمدد الروحاني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Eating means nourishing oneself with fitting spiritual states, morals, gifts, and provisions, including contentment, patience, knowledge, perceptions, intentions, and stations.
rows.anchor: اغتذوا وتقووا بما يختص بكم من الأحوال والأخلاق والأمداد والمواهب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Grazing livestock refers to animal faculties and the morals and manners specific to them.
rows.anchor: القوى الحيوانية بما يختص بها من الأخلاق والآداب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being created from earth means being formed according to the different temperaments of bodily organs that manifest the faculties.
rows.anchor: أنشأناكم على حسب اختلاف أمزجة الأعضاء التي هي مظاهرها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Returning to earth means annihilation through discipline: each faculty settles in its place, ceases to act or exceed bounds, and loses self-attributes.
rows.anchor: بإماتة عند الرياضة حتى يلازم كل محله ويندس فيه لا حراك به ولا يتطلب التجاوز عن حده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being brought forth again means receiving true life through subsistence, so the faculties’ movements become balanced and their dispositions prevail.
rows.anchor: عند البقاء بالحياة الموهوبة الحقيقية فتعتدل حركاتها وتفضل ملكاتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The right side of the Mount is the heart’s mountain, facing the Holy Spirit and serving as the locus of revelation, called the inner inspiration and heart.
rows.anchor: الذي يلي روح القدس وهو محل الوحي الذي يسمونه الروع والفؤاد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What was sent down means spiritual states and experiential ways, together with manna-like knowledge and certainty-based gnosis.
rows.anchor: من الأحوال والمذاهب من الذوقيات وسلوى العلوم والمعارف من اليقينيات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Eating wholesome provisions means feeding the heart with good knowledge and receiving it, since it gives the heart life.
rows.anchor: أي: تغذوا تلك المعارف الطيبة وتقبلوها بقلوبكم فإنها سبب حياتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Transgression is the ego’s self-display and conceit when it sees its beauty, perfection, and adornment in the light it receives.
rows.anchor: بظهور النفس وإعجابها بنفسها عند استشراقها ورؤيتها بهجتها وكمالها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The resulting wrath is deprivation and abandonment; falling means leaving nearness for the self’s hell and being veiled from the light of beauty.
rows.anchor: { فيحل عليكم } غضب الحرمان وآفة الخذلان { فقد هوى } سقط عن مقام القرب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s being forgiving means veiling the self’s rebellious attributes that parade themselves and claim independence through the lights of His attributes.
rows.anchor: لستار صفات النفس الطاغية الظاهرة بتزييناتها واستغنائها بأنوار صفاتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Repentance is turning from the self’s display and control, and seeking forgiveness through brokenness, abasement, and acknowledged need.
rows.anchor: استغفر بانكسارها وانقماعها ولزومها ذل فاقتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Faith is belief in the lights of the heart’s attributes and divine light; good works acquire stations such as trust and contentment, preserving presence and purity.
rows.anchor: بأنوار الصفات القلبية وتجليات الأنوار الإلهية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Then being guided means reaching the light of the divine essence and the state of annihilation.
rows.anchor: إلى نور الذات وحال الفناء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mountains are embodied existences of bodies; alternatively, they are things’ events, pulverized by divine inspirations from the source of unity.
rows.anchor: { ويسألونك عن الجبال } أي: وجودات الأبدان { فقل ينسفها ربي } برياح الحوادث

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mountains’ destruction leaves no remainder, reducing them to scattered dust and leveling them with the earth.
rows.anchor: لا بقية منها ولا أثر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The level plain of the greater resurrection is pure unity, with no duality or otherness to disturb its evenness.
rows.anchor: في القيامة الكبرى { قاعا صفصفا } وجودا أحديا صرفا { لا ترى فيها } إثنينية ولا غيرية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At the greater resurrection, people follow God, with no movement or life except through Him, and no deviation from His straight course and will.
rows.anchor: الذي هو الحق، لا حراك بهم ولا حياة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All voices become low because the voice belongs to God alone, and only a faint whisper is heard relative to the manifestations.
rows.anchor: { وخشعت الأصوات } انخفضت كلها لأن الصوت صوته فحسب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, at the lesser resurrection people follow Israfil, governor of the fourth sphere and giver of life, and none departs from the divinely wise attachment to him.
rows.anchor: الذي هو إسرافيل مدبر الفلك الرابع، المفيض للحياة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the lesser resurrection, voices fall silent in calls to anything besides what the Merciful calls to; only whispers of false thoughts and wishes remain.
rows.anchor: { وخشعت الأصوات } في الدعاء إلى غير ما دعا إليه الرحمن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Intercession is by someone the person loved and followed in earthly life; it helps only when the Merciful permits acceptance according to the recipient’s preparedness.
rows.anchor: أي: شفاعة من تولاه وأحبه في الحياة الدنيا ممن اقتدى به وتمسك بهدايته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The effusion of complete souls toward deficient souls depends on the latter’s receptive purity; this readiness is what permission means.
rows.anchor: فإن فيض النفوس الكاملة التي تتوجه إليها النفوس الناقصة بالإرادة والرغبة موقوفة على استعدادها لقبوله بالصفاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s approval of a word means approving an influence suited to the recipient; intercession requires both the intercessor’s capacity to influence and the recipient’s capacity to receive.
rows.anchor: فتتوقف الشفاعة على أمرين: قدرة الشفيع على التأثير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knows both parties’ capacities: original receptivity and the intercessor’s illumination, as well as bodily obstacles or dispositions acquired through ethical training under practical reason.
rows.anchor: من قوة القبول بالاستعداد الأصلي وتأثير الشفيع بالتنوير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each community of faculties is given a distinct worship to remember God by embodying His attributes and turning toward unity.
rows.anchor: عبادة مخصوصة بها { ليذكروا اسم الله } بالاتصاف بصفاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The provision comes by way of the animal self, itself one of the sound souls.
rows.anchor: الكمال بواسطة { بهيمة } النفس التي هي من جملة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since God is one, people should turn toward Him alone and obey no one else.
rows.anchor: فوحدوه بالتوجه نحوه من غير التفات إلى غيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The humble are broken and submissive before God, ready to receive His effusion.
rows.anchor: { وبشر } المنكسرين المتذللين القابلين لفيضه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Remembering God with presence makes hearts tremble and receive His effusion; patience is steadfastness through opposition and spiritual struggle.
rows.anchor: بالحضور { وجلت قلوبهم } انفعلت لقبول فيضه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their prayer is contemplative witnessing; spending means annihilating virtues and perfections in God and pouring them out to prepared recipients.
rows.anchor: صلاة المشاهدة { ومما رزقناهم } من الفضائل والكمالات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sacrificial camels signify noble, precious souls, made as offerings for people and as a source of felicity and perfection.
rows.anchor: { والبدن } أي: النفوس الشريفة العظيمة القدر { جعلناها } من الهدايا المعلمة لله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Naming God over them means embodying His attributes and effacing one’s own; this is sacrifice in God’s path.
rows.anchor: وذلك هو النحر في سبيل الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Standing in rows means upholding what God made obligatory, bounded by the law and the path’s manners, and stopping one’s restless movement.
rows.anchor: مقيدات بقيود الشريعة، وآداب الطريقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their falling on their sides means dying to the desire and power by which the self lives, acts independently, and becomes restless.
rows.anchor: سقطت عن هواها الذي هو حياتها وقوتها التي بها تستقل وتضطرب بقتلها في الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Eating from them means benefiting from their virtues and sharing them with prepared people and seekers who present themselves to ask.
rows.anchor: استفيدوا من فضائلها وأفيدوا المستعدين والطالبين المتعرضين للطلب من المريدين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God subjected them through spiritual discipline so people give thanks for their preparedness and success by using them in God’s path.
rows.anchor: نعمة الاستعداد والتوفيق باستعمالها في سبيل الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is not reached by the souls’ virtues and perfection, but by detachment from their qualities; arrival comes through detachment and annihilation, not merely replacing vices with virtues.
rows.anchor: { لن ينال الله } لحوم فضائلها وكمالاتها ولا إفناؤها بإزالة أهوائها التي هي دماؤها { ولكن يناله } التجرد { منكم } عنها وعن صفاتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sacrifice is subjected so people magnify God by annihilating themselves in Him and leaving everything through purification and individuation toward reality.
rows.anchor: { سخرها لكم لتكبروا الله } بالفناء فيه عنها وعن كل شيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The good-doers witness in servitude while passing through subsistence and annihilation in steadfastness and stability.
rows.anchor: الشاهدين في العبودية عن البقاء والفناء حال الاستقامة والتمكين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On Judgment Day, lasting kingship belongs to the Merciful, who bears attributes of gentleness and severity and gives each its due.
rows.anchor: الموصوف بجميع صفات اللطف والقهر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the final resurrection, no one can rescue the punished or seek refuge elsewhere: attachments fail and the Merciful’s unrestricted dominion appears.
rows.anchor: لزوال كل ملك باطل ولا قدرة حينئذ لأحد على إنجاء المعذبين منه ولا يمكنهم الالتجاء بغيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, in the middle resurrection, the heart’s sky splits with tranquility and spiritual powers descend with divine aid and attribute-lights, so the Merciful rules the heart and manifests His attributes.
rows.anchor: أو يوم تشقق سماء القلب بغمام نور السكينة وتنزل ملائكة القوى الروحانية بالأمداد الإلهية والأنوار الصفاتية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The day is hard for disbelievers because bodily ruin brings punishment through dark dispositions and the force of heavenly powers; in the middle resurrection, suffering is exposed to the witness.
rows.anchor: أما على الأول فلتعذبهم عند خراب البدن بالهيئات المظلمة وقهر القوى السماوية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the middle resurrection, the witness sees no independent agent or other conqueror sharing power; alternatively, disbelievers are subdued psychic faculties punished by discipline.
rows.anchor: وأما على الثاني فلظهور تعذبهم في شهود صاحب هذه القيامة واطلاعه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Anyone veiled by something and stopping with it loves and resembles it, and thus truly worships passion through worship of that beloved.
rows.anchor: كل محجوب بشيء واقف معه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan prompts love of things besides God; loving anything for its own sake makes one worship the beloved, one’s passion, and Satan, dividing one’s orientation among gods.
rows.anchor: والباعث لهواه على محبة غير الله هو الشيطان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person already veiled by a shadow of God is far removed, so the Prophet cannot be their guardian by calling them to unity.
rows.anchor: بدعوته إلى التوحيد وقد كان في غاية البعد محجوبا بظل من ظلاله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The shadow signifies derived, relative existence: things’ essences are shadows of the Real and attributes of universal existence.
rows.anchor: اعلم أن ماهيات الأشياء وحقائق الأعيان هي ظل الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Stretching the shadow is bringing things forth through the Name Light, outward existence that reveals them and brings their hidden state into relative existence.
rows.anchor: فمدها إظهارها باسمه النور الذي هو الوجود الظاهر الخارجي الذي يظهر به كل شيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If God made the shadow still, it would remain fixed in the hidden storehouse of existence, the Mother Book and Preserved Tablet, not absolute nothingness.
rows.anchor: أي: أم الكتاب واللوح المحفوظ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pure nonbeing cannot receive existence; what has no hidden reality in God’s knowledge and unseen realm could never appear outwardly.
rows.anchor: وما ليس له وجود في الباطن وخزانة علم الحق وغيبه لم يمكن وجوده أصلا في الظاهر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Creation and annihilation only manifest what is fixed in the unseen or conceal it; God is the Manifest and the Hidden.
rows.anchor: والإيجاد والإعدام ليس إلا إظهار ما هو ثابت في الغيب وإخفاؤه فحسب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sun of intellect makes the shadow a proof that its essence differs from its existence; otherwise intellect could not distinguish a thing from existence.
rows.anchor: يهدي إلى أن حقيقته غير وجوده وإلا فلا مغايرة بينهما في الخارج

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Drawing the shadow back means annihilating it; what vanishes is small compared with what preceded and soon appears in another locus.
rows.anchor: لأن كل ما يفنى من الموجودات في كل وقت فهو يسير بالقياس إلى ما سبق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The drawing-in shows annihilation is not absolute nonbeing, but withholding a thing from manifestation while intellect preserves its image and essence eternally.
rows.anchor: والقبض دليل على أن الإفناء ليس إعداما محضا بل هو منع عن الانتشار في قبضته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being told to prostrate means being commanded to annihilate oneself in all God’s attributes and obey through them; refusal reflects inadequate receptivity or ignorance and veiling from this name and the attributes.
rows.anchor: إذا أمرتهم بالفناء في جميع صفاته وطاعته بها أنكروا ولم يمتثلوا أمرك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses’ being among the astray means he was not an unbeliever but one not yet guided to the path of unity.
rows.anchor: { وأنا من الضالين } أي: لست من الكافرين لكون الصلاح في ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wisdom God granted Moses transcends demonstration, acquisition, and reason, and God made him a messenger with it.
rows.anchor: حكمة متعالية عن طريق البرهان وراء طور الكسب والعقل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh’s enslavement of Israel was oppression, not a favor: bodily nature cast Moses into the body-coffin in prime matter, while spiritual powers would have raised him otherwise.
rows.anchor: إذ لو لم تعبدهم لما ألقتني أمي الطبيعة البدنية

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: The account says Pharaoh was a logician who asked about God’s essence; Moses answered by naming the Lord of the heavens, earth, and what lies between them.
rows.anchor: قيل في القصة: إن فرعون كان منطقيا مباحثا سأل بما هو عن حقيقته تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses indicates God’s essence cannot be defined: its simplicity, intense light, and subtlety put it beyond reason, so he identifies God by an attribute and necessary feature.
rows.anchor: وبين أن حقيقته لا تعرف بالحد لبساطتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase if you are certain indirectly rebukes Pharaoh: certainty knows reason can infer God only from His acts, while His essence is known only to Himself.
rows.anchor: لو كنتم من أهل الإيقان لعلمتم أن لا طريق للعقل إلى معرفته إلا الاستدلال على وجوده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses exposes Pharaoh’s lightness of mind before his people; when Pharaoh repeats the question, Moses taunts him that if Moses is mad, Pharaoh should know reason’s limits.
rows.anchor: استخفه ونبه قومه على خفة عقله وكون جوابه غير مطابق للسؤال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The passage depicts the veiled self as unable to know the Real, prophetic wisdom, or religious law; it resists obedience, asserts itself, and seeks to overpower revelation.
rows.anchor: وهذه المقالة إشارة إلى أن النفس المحجوبة بمعقولها لا تهتدي إلى معرفة الحق وحكمة الرسالة والشرع
